$comment: The consumer contract, as data. Every id is <kind>.<the program, target or file it is about>. One entry per thing a reusable workflow reaches for in the calling repository. This table is the single source for three consumers: bin/check-contract.mjs, docs/adopting-an-existing-repo.md (generated from it), and test/consumer-contract.bats (which holds it against docs/consumer-guide.md's own tables). Adding a requirement to a workflow without adding it here is the drift this file exists to prevent.

$schema-notes.kind: How to check it. package-script: package.json scripts[target]. package-dep: a dependency or devDependency named target. file: any one of target exists. dir-nonempty: target is a directory with at least one entry. pinned-tool: a mise config declares [tools] target. ignores-workflows: target's config text excludes the .workflows checkout. ignores-workflows-or-narrow: the same, but also satisfied when the config declares no tree-wide (**/) glob, so nothing of ours is in its reach to begin with. caller-path: an input in the caller names a consumer-relative path, which must then exist. one-pin: every shared-workflows call pins one full commit SHA with its # vX.Y.Z, and each of this family's packages in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml is at that commit (target unused). lane: the Fastfile (fastlane/**.rb) defines each lane in target, as platform:lane. lane-environment: the lanes read no environment variable with the row's prefix that is not in target. make-ci-reaches-ci and ci-runs-make-ci: `make <target>` and CI run the same gates, one direction each. no-copy: none of target exists, because this family already ships it and a consumer's own copy only drifts from it; the list names the paths a copy has had in a consumer and grows as each one is deleted.
$schema-notes.toggle: The workflow_call input that decides whether this is needed at all, as `workflow.yml:input`. The contract check reads the caller's own `with:` block first and falls back to defaultOn.
$schema-notes.severity: required: the gate cannot run without it and the job dies. degrades: shared-workflows has a fallback, so the gate still runs but not as the consumer defined it. optional: nothing happens unless the consumer opts in.

requirements.neededBy: the setup action, in every job of every workflow
requirements.fix: Add a .mise.toml with a [tools] table declaring at least node and pnpm. jdx/mise-action installs from it, and with no config it installs nothing - the first symptom is 'missing command: pnpm' several steps later.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (release), and every fastlane lane workflow
requirements.fix: Add ruby to your .mise.toml [tools] table. scripts/ci/ruby-version.sh reads the pin from there and hands it to ruby/setup-ruby.

requirements.neededBy: every script gate, through scripts/checks/run-script.sh
requirements.fix: This family runs a consumer's package.json scripts by name. A repository without one cannot satisfy any gate.

requirements.neededBy: the setup action (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile), and scripts/ci/native-hash.sh
requirements.fix: Run pnpm install and commit pnpm-lock.yaml. This family is pnpm-only: there is no npm or yarn path, and the native cache key is read straight out of the lockfile before any install runs.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (types)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:types" script, or pass types: false in your caller.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (lint)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:lint" script, or pass lint: false in your caller.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (format)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:format" script, or pass format: false in your caller.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (unused)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:unused" script (the template runs knip there), or pass unused: false in your caller.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (spell)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:spell" script, or pass spell: false in your caller.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (docs)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:docs" script deciding what 'docs are in order' means for your repository, or pass docs: false in your caller. This is a house-invented name rather than a convention, so it is the most common first red on adoption.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (licenses)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:licenses" script enforcing your dependency license policy, or pass licenses: false in your caller. Another house-invented name with no fallback.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (expo-health)
requirements.fix: Without a "check:expo-health" script, shared-workflows runs its own scripts/checks/expo-health.sh instead: `expo install --check` as a warning, then expo-doctor with its version check off. The gate you define and the gate CI runs should be the same gate, so point the script at that file (bash node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/checks/expo-health.sh).

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (audit)
requirements.fix: Without a "check:audit" script, shared-workflows runs its own scripts/checks/audit.sh, which is `pnpm audit` alone - no lockfile provenance check.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (ci)
requirements.fix: Without a "check:ci" script, shared-workflows runs its own scripts/ci/check-ci.sh. That one already skips cleanly when you have neither scripts/ nor .github/workflows/, so this is the gentlest of the fallbacks.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (secrets)
requirements.fix: Without a "check:secrets" script, shared-workflows runs its own scripts/checks/secrets.sh: gitleaks over your whole git history with its default rules and any .gitleaks.toml at your root. Ship the script when you want the same scan as a make target, or pass secrets: false.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (generated)
requirements.fix: Without a "check:generated" script, shared-workflows runs its own scripts/checks/generated.sh, which calls your "gen:i18n" and "gen:graphql" (whichever you have) and asserts no diff.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (prebuild)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:prebuild" script, or leave prebuild off. It is minutes rather than seconds, which is why it is off by default.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (release)
requirements.fix: Add a "check:release" script, or leave release off. Only a consumer with a fastlane release setup ships one.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (commits), pr-title.yml
requirements.fix: Without @commitlint/cli as a devDependency, scripts/checks/commits.sh falls back to npx with a pinned default config - a network fetch, and your own commitlint.config is not what runs.

requirements.neededBy: check.yml (release) via bundler-cache, and scripts/release/fastlane.sh
requirements.fix: release sets up Ruby with bundler-cache, which needs a Gemfile and a committed Gemfile.lock.

requirements.neededBy: test-unit.yml (coverage-script)
requirements.fix: Add a "test:coverage" script, or call test-unit.yml with coverage: false so it runs "test" instead.

requirements.neededBy: test-unit.yml (scripts-script)
requirements.fix: Add a "test:scripts" script that tests your own scripts/ directory, or pass scripts-script: '' in your caller - an empty value skips the step entirely.

requirements.label: make ci reaches every CI gate
requirements.neededBy: check.yml and test-unit.yml, against your Makefile
requirements.fix: Every package script the check and test-unit workflows run for your caller must be reachable from `make ci`, by name or through a target of the dashed name (check:docs is make check-docs). Add the gate to a target `make ci` reaches, or switch it off in your caller. No Makefile, or no ci target, and this is skipped.

requirements.label: CI runs every make ci gate
requirements.neededBy: your Makefile, against check.yml and test-unit.yml
requirements.fix: Every target `make ci` reaches that has a recipe of its own must be run by CI: named like a script CI runs (check-docs for check:docs), or running only pnpm scripts CI runs. Fold a local-only gate into a script CI already runs, or turn its CI toggle on. Otherwise a green `make ci` claims checks CI never makes.

requirements.neededBy: test-e2e.yml and every build workflow, through scripts/lib/expo-config.sh
requirements.fix: These workflows are Expo-specific. The app name, scheme, iOS bundle identifier and Android package are read with `expo config --json`, so an Expo config has to resolve.

requirements.neededBy: test-e2e.yml (flows)
requirements.fix: Add at least one Maestro flow under .maestro/, or point flows at the directory you use. An empty selection is not a pass: the suite asserts it actually ran flows.

requirements.neededBy: test-e2e.yml, through scripts/e2e/run-hook.sh
requirements.fix: A hook input that names a file which does not exist is fatal - deliberately, because a silently skipped setup hook produces a confusing suite failure later. Leave the input empty if you ship no hook.

requirements.neededBy: build-web.yml (build-script)
requirements.fix: Add a "build:web" script that writes dist/index.html, or pass a different build-script.

requirements.neededBy: build-web.yml (e2e)
requirements.fix: Add a "test:e2e:web" script that honours PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_EXPORT=1 and tests the existing dist/ export rather than making its own, or pass playwright: false.

requirements.neededBy: build-web.yml, through scripts/web/playwright-version.sh
requirements.fix: Add @playwright/test as a devDependency. The browser download is keyed on the version resolved from your lockfile, so it is read there before any install.

requirements.label: no copy of gen-badges
requirements.neededBy: the gen-badges program @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships and publish-badges.yml runs; a copy in your repository is compared with it by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its tests, and point any script that ran it at the package's program ("gen:badges": "gen-badges"). publish-badges.yml already renders with gen-badges unless your caller names a script in badges-script.

requirements.neededBy: check-code-scanning.yml (configuration-file)
requirements.fix: Add .github/codeql/codeql-config.yml, or pass configuration-file: '' in your caller. Without it the analysis still runs, on CodeQL's own defaults - so your path exclusions and the alert-suppression pack that makes an inline // codeql[rule-id] marker count are not applied.

requirements.label: no copy of the security scanners
requirements.neededBy: the scanners, the settings resolver and the verdict check-security.yml runs from this family (scripts/security/, packages/app-tooling/lib/security-*.mjs) and @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships as check-security; a copy in your repository is run by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete scripts/security/ (the runners, the settings resolver, the SARIF helpers, the verdict and their tests), keep security-settings.json (and the files it names, such as jobs.code.rules), and point your local security command at the package's program ("check-security", or "check-security <job>" for one scanner).

requirements.neededBy: the settings resolver (packages/app-tooling/lib/security-settings.mjs) the Settings job and every runner read it with
requirements.fix: Add security-settings.json to set severity, failOn, per-job enabled flags and options; @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/security-settings.json is every key at its default, ready to copy. Without it the built-in defaults apply.

requirements.neededBy: build-ios.yml, build-android.yml, publish-store.yml
requirements.fix: The release workflows run named fastlane lanes. Ship a fastlane/Fastfile whose before_all asserts APP_VERSION, APP_BUILD_NUMBER, IOS_BUNDLE_ID, IOS_SCHEME and ANDROID_PACKAGE and rejects an empty value - that assertion is the only thing standing between an unset repository variable and a build signed with an empty identifier.

requirements.neededBy: build-ios.yml, build-android.yml
requirements.fix: Define the four build lanes. A Fastfile that exists but lacks a lane fails inside fastlane with 'Could not find lane', after prebuild and pod install have already been paid for.

requirements.label: APP_REVIEW_* names the lanes read
requirements.neededBy: publish-store.yml, which passes exactly these as secrets
requirements.fix: Your lanes read an APP_REVIEW_* environment variable that publish-store.yml does not pass, so it is always empty on a runner and fastlane submits the empty value. Rename it to one of the listed names, or propose the new secret in shared-workflows first.

requirements.label: no copy of the release verifiers
requirements.neededBy: the release verifiers @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships as release/verify-ios.sh and release/verify-android.sh (with lib/verify-common.sh), which your verify lanes run; a copy in your repository is compared with them by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copies and their tests, and point your verify lanes at the package's: bash node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/release/verify-ios.sh <ipa-or-app> [--no-signing], and release/verify-android.sh <aab> <apk> [--cert-sha256 X].

requirements.label: no copy of the machine setup or the doctor
requirements.neededBy: the machine setup (setup/*.sh) and the doctor (bin/doctor.mjs, doctor.requirements.json) @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships; a copy in your repository is compared with them by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copies and their tests, run bash node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/setup/all.sh (or toolchain.sh, android.sh, ios.sh) and pnpm exec doctor instead, and keep only your own additions in doctor.requirements.json, which the doctor merges over the package's by name.

requirements.neededBy: build-prepare.yml and publish-ota.yml, through scripts/lib/release-env.sh
requirements.fix: Add @expo/fingerprint as a devDependency. The native fingerprints go into build-info.json and are what the OTA gate compares - an update whose fingerprint differs from the installed binary crashes every user on the channel.

requirements.neededBy: your own lint gate, which walks the whole tree
requirements.fix: Add "!**/.workflows" to files.includes in biome.json. Every job checks this repository out into .workflows/, and a tool that globs the whole tree will lint files you do not own.

requirements.neededBy: your own lint gate, which walks the whole tree
requirements.fix: Add '.workflows/**' to the flat-config ignores array in eslint.config.mjs.

requirements.neededBy: your own type check gate
requirements.fix: Add ".workflows" to exclude in tsconfig.json.

requirements.neededBy: your own unused-code gate
requirements.fix: Add ".workflows/**" to ignore in knip.json, or keep every project/entry glob rooted so none of them reaches into it. The second is what the template does, and it is why this row is satisfied there without an ignore entry.

requirements.neededBy: your own spell gate
requirements.fix: Add ".workflows/" to [files] extend-exclude in typos.toml.

requirements.neededBy: test-unit.yml, which runs your test script over the whole tree
requirements.fix: Add '/\\.workflows/' to testPathIgnorePatterns in jest.config.ts. This repository ships its own *.test.mjs files, and a jest-expo project will collect them and die on import.meta - a red Unit job over a file you do not own.

requirements.neededBy: your own working tree
requirements.fix: Add /.workflows to .gitignore. The setup action writes .git/info/exclude instead, which is local-only, so this is a convenience rather than a requirement - but without it a local .workflows/ checkout shows up as untracked.

requirements.label: no copy of check-coverage-empty
requirements.neededBy: the check-coverage-empty program @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships; a copy in your repository is compared with it by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its test, and point the script that runs it at the package's program ("check:coverage-empty": "check-coverage-empty").

requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its test, and run the package's check-diagrams program from the docs check instead.

requirements.fix: Delete the test that reimplements it, and run the package's check-make-target-names program from make check instead.

requirements.fix: Delete the test that reimplements it, and run the package's check-shell-locale program from make check instead.

requirements.fix: Delete the test that reimplements it, and run the package's check-workflow-names program from make check instead.

requirements.label: no copy of resolve-version.sh
requirements.neededBy: release/resolve-version.sh, which @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships and build-prepare.yml runs; a copy in your repository is compared with it by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its test, and run node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/release/resolve-version.sh (make version) instead.

requirements.label: one shared-workflows commit everywhere
requirements.neededBy: every call and every package of this family, read at one commit: a pin bump that moves the workflows and not the packages runs CI on one commit and a laptop on another
requirements.fix: Pin every shared-workflows call to the same full commit SHA with its # vX.Y.Z beside it, then run pnpm exec fix-tooling-pin to move this family's packages and the lockfile to that commit.

requirements.label: no copy of fix-tooling-pin

requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its test, and run pnpm exec fix-tooling-pin (make fix-tooling-pin) instead.

requirements.label: no copy of check-contract
requirements.neededBy: check-contract, which @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships: its one-pin row holds the pins and its call rows hold every call to its workflow's interface
requirements.fix: Delete the copies, and run pnpm exec check-contract (make check-contract) instead.

requirements.label: no copy of check-lockfile
requirements.neededBy: the check-lockfile program @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships; a copy in your repository is compared with it by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its test, and run pnpm exec check-lockfile instead.

requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its tests, and run node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/release/build-info.sh --standalone on a laptop instead.

requirements.label: no copy of the generated-file check
requirements.neededBy: checks/generated.sh, which @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships and check.yml runs; a copy in your repository is compared with it by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copies, and point check:generated at bash node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/checks/generated.sh; it runs your gen:i18n and gen:graphql scripts, whichever you have, and fails on a diff.

requirements.label: no copy of the CI check
requirements.neededBy: ci/check-ci.sh, which @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships and check.yml runs: actionlint, zizmor and shellcheck at the pinned versions
requirements.fix: Delete the copy, and run bash node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/ci/check-ci.sh; WORKFLOWS_SHELLCHECK_PATHS names the directories to lint when scripts/ is not all of them.

requirements.label: no copy of gen-store-notes
requirements.neededBy: the gen-store-notes program @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships, which build-prepare.yml and pr-store-notes.yml run through scripts/release/gen-store-notes.sh; a copy in your repository is not run, and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copy, its tests and its fixtures. The workflows run the package's store-notes, and a laptop runs pnpm exec gen-store-notes --from-commits --out -. Keep only what your app adds to the prompt (its product, audience and tone) in store-notes.prompt.md; a test that needs a release body reads $WORKFLOWS_DIR/packages/app-tooling/fixtures/store-notes/.

requirements.label: no copy of the LLM adapters
requirements.neededBy: the provider-portable LLM adapters @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling ships (@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/llm and /llm-request), which its gen-store-notes program uses; a copy in your repository is compared with them by nothing and drifts
requirements.fix: Delete the copies and their tests, and import from the package instead: adapterFor, KEY_ENV, EFFORTS, parseEffort and parseExtraParams from @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/llm, and thinks, mergeRequest and unfence from @blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/llm-request.

requirements.fix: Delete the test that reimplements it, put its rules in the testSiblings section of app-tooling.json, and run pnpm exec check-test-siblings from make check instead.

requirements.fix: Delete the test that reimplements it, and run pnpm exec check-ignored-directories from make check instead.

requirements.fix: Delete the copies and their tests, put your architecture paths and target-name exceptions in the docs section of app-tooling.json, and point make check-docs at pnpm exec check-docs.

requirements.fix: Delete the copy and its test, and point check:licenses at check-licenses; a license only your repository accepts goes in an --allow.
